body.value: Plitvice Lakes National Park is Croatia’s oldest and most famous national park, and a UNESCO World Heritage site.
The park is known for its series of turquoise lakes connected by spectacular waterfalls, surrounded by dense forests and wooden walkways.
Visitors can explore the park via well-maintained trails and boardwalks that allow close views of the lakes without disturbing the natural environment.
Plitvice is beautiful year-round: lush and green in spring and summer, colorful in autumn, and frozen into a winter wonderland during colder months.
To avoid crowds, it is recommended to arrive early in the morning or visit during the shoulder seasons in spring or autumn.
Known for Skradinski Buk waterfall and walking paths.
